name: complete-invention-disclosures-rd
description: An English-first invention disclosure completion assistant for inventors, R&D teams, in-house IP teams, and patent professionals. It packages a standalone customer-facing HTML guide that collects invention information through a structured seven-step workflow and generates a reviewable disclosure draft without claiming to provide patent drafting or legal advice.

outputs.name: disclosure-guide
outputs.description: Standalone English customer-facing invention disclosure guide with guided inventor input, writing prompts, completeness review, safe draft generation, and copy/download support.

outputs.name: invention-disclosure-draft
outputs.description: A structured invention disclosure draft rendered inside the HTML page for inventor and qualified patent-professional review.

extra.legal_boundary: not a patent application or legal opinion
